refnamediv.refpurpose: Uruguayan eID card (cédula de identidad) setup utility

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: The cedulauy-tool utility sets up the Uruguayan eID card for use over its contactless (NFC) interface. That interface is protected with PACE, and the only password the card accepts is the machine readable zone (MRZ) of the document: the three lines of 30 characters printed on the back. OpenSC only recognizes the card over NFC once its MRZ is known, so this tool has to be run before the card can be used contactless.

The MRZ is stored in the OpenSC file cache directory (see file_cache_dir in opensc.conf5). The file holds the MRZ, and with it the document number, name and date of birth, in the clear; it is created readable only by the user. Alternatively, the MRZ can be given in the CEDULAUY_MRZ environment variable, which takes precedence over the stored one.

listitem.para: Causes cedulauy-tool to be more verbose. Specify this flag several times to enable debug output.
Number of the reader to use with --read-mrz. By default, the first reader with a present card is used. If arg is an ATR, the reader with a matching card will be chosen.
Causes cedulauy-tool to wait for the card to be inserted into the reader.
Read the MRZ from the card in a contact reader, where it is accessible without a PIN, and store it.
